parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Cement is made by heating a mixture of calcium carbonate and powdered clay.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Choose from the list the name of the substance which contains calcium carbonate. Draw a circle around the correct answer. bauxite hematite limestone slaked lime [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Complete the word equation for the thermal decomposition of calcium carbonate. calcium carbonate ........................ ........................ + ........................ ........................ [2]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Carbon dioxide is produced when dilute hydrochloric acid reacts with powdered calcium carbonate. CaCO 3 + 2HC l → CaC l 2 + CO 2 + H 2 O

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Complete the diagram to show the apparatus used to investigate the volume of carbon dioxide produced during this reaction. [2]

ms.label: 5(c)(i)
ms.text:
flask or other suitable container and workable apparatus (1)
connecting tubing AND apparatus gas-tight / no air gaps (1)

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Suggest the name of another piece of apparatus that can be used to measure the volume of carbon dioxide produced. ....................................................................................................................................... [1]

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Describe the effect of each of the following on the rate of reaction of dilute hydrochloric acid with calcium carbonate. ● Large pieces of calcium carbonate are used instead of powdered calcium carbonate. All other conditions stay the same. ............................................................................................................................................. ● The temperature is decreased. All other conditions stay the same. ............................................................................................................................................. [2]

ms.label: 5(c)(iv)
ms.text:
large pieces: rate decreases / (reaction) slower / rate lower (1)
lower temperature: rate decreases / (reaction) slower / rate lower (1)

ms.label: 5(d)
ms.text:
(increase concentration of carbon dioxide) traps energy from the Sun / absorbs energy from the Sun (1)
increase in atmospheric temperature / increase in global temperature / (increased) greenhouse effect / global warming (1)
